threads.assignment: Shared contracts only. Export every new public API named in the roadmap from the package indexes: HeteroData from torch_geometric/data/__init__.py; Linear, to_hetero and to_hetero_with_bases from torch_geometric/nn/__init__.py; HGTConv, HeteroConv, GeneralConv and PDNConv from torch_geometric/nn/conv/__init__.py; GCN, GraphSAGE, GIN, GAT and RECT_L from torch_geometric/nn/models/__init__.py; RandomLinkSplit and the new transform base class from torch_geometric/transforms/__init__.py; and count_parameters, get_model_size, get_data_size, get_cpu_memory_from_gc and timeit from the new torch_geometric/profile/__init__.py. Add type aliases to torch_geometric/typing.py for a node type (a string), an edge type (a (source, relation, destination) triple of strings) and the metadata pair that HeteroData.metadata() returns (the list of node types, the list of edge types), for the data, convolution and conversion code to share. Give each API a stub module carrying the roadmap's exact signature where the module does not exist yet (other threads implement them), except Linear, which gets a minimal working version in a new module under torch_geometric/nn (in_channels=-1 defers allocating the weight until the first forward; t4 completes it) so the operators built on it can be written against it. Nothing else.

Target 1 (Heterogeneous Graph Data Storage): under torch_geometric/data, add the storage hierarchy (a base storage with mutable-mapping semantics: attribute access, deletion, keys/values/items optionally filtered by attribute name, equality and length; node and edge storages carrying _key and _parent), refactor Data in torch_geometric/data/data.py onto a common base shared with HeteroData (device transfer, apply, iteration over its stores through the stores property) while keeping Data's existing API, Batch, the data loaders and TemporalData working, and implement HeteroData over t0's stub: node-type and edge-type indexing that returns the same store on every access (an edge type given as two node types infers the relation 'to'), keyword (double-underscore separated), dict and attribute construction, graph-level attributes, metadata(), collect() with the x_dict-style shorthand, keys, num_nodes, num_edges, to_dict(), to_namedtuple(), shallow and deep copy, and to_homogeneous() (node and edge attributes concatenated across types, remapped edge indices, an edge_type tensor and the slice/type mappings), with tests under test/data. The torch_geometric.data export of HeteroData and the node/edge type aliases in torch_geometric/typing.py belong to t0.

Target 3 (Heterogeneous Graph Transformer Convolution), Target 4 (Generic Heterogeneous Convolution Wrapper), Target 7 (General-Purpose Convolution Operator), Target 8 (Pathfinder Discovery Network Convolution) and Target 12 (Message-Passing Hook System): implement HGTConv (per-node-type key/query/value projections, per-relation attention parameters, uniform, per-type or lazy -1 input sizes, a dict forward over edge-index tensors or SparseTensor adjacencies with identical results, multiple heads), HeteroConv (per-edge-type dispatch, results sharing a destination type combined by aggr, the _dict keyword passthrough, reset_parameters()), GeneralConv and PDNConv under torch_geometric/nn/conv over t0's stubs, using t0's Linear for lazy input sizes; add the hook system to MessagePassing in torch_geometric/nn/conv/message_passing.py (the eight registration methods the roadmap lists, pre-hooks that may return replacement inputs, post-hooks that receive inputs and outputs and may return replacement outputs, and handles with remove()), keeping the jittable template torch_geometric/nn/conv/message_passing.jinja in step; tests under test/nn/conv. The torch_geometric.nn.conv exports, the type aliases in torch_geometric/typing.py and the Linear contract belong to t0.

Target 6 (Pre-built GNN Model Classes), Target 9 (RECT-L Model for Imbalanced Labels), Target 10 (Random Edge-Level Split Transform) and Target 11 (Profiling Utilities Package): under torch_geometric/nn/models, implement the abstract base GNN model (the roadmap's constructor; activation, optional normalization, dropout, and jk modes 'last', 'cat', 'max' and 'lstm' reusing JumpingKnowledge) with GCN, GraphSAGE, GIN and GAT on top of it (GAT with heads, its per-layer output still hidden_channels), and RECT_L (forward GCN, dropout, linear; embed(); get_semantic_labels() for the masked nodes only); under torch_geometric/transforms, add the transform base class and RandomLinkSplit (num_val and num_test as counts or fractions, undirected edge pairs kept together, negative edges at neg_sampling_ratio, progressive message-passing context from train to val to test, a 3-tuple of data objects carrying edge_label_index and edge_label); under torch_geometric/profile, implement count_parameters, get_model_size, get_data_size (sparse storage included, tensors sharing a storage counted once), get_cpu_memory_from_gc and the timeit() decorator; tests under test/. The exports in torch_geometric/nn/models/__init__.py, torch_geometric/transforms/__init__.py and torch_geometric/profile/__init__.py belong to t0; the convolution operators these models use belong to t2.

Target 2 (Lazy-Initializing Linear Layer) and Target 5 (Automatic Heterogeneous Model Conversion): complete Linear over t0's minimal version (weight deferred when in_channels is -1 while the bias is allocated at construction; weight_initializer 'glorot', 'kaiming_uniform' or None and bias_initializer 'zeros' or None; the same weights and outputs as the standard PyTorch linear layer under the defaults and a fixed seed; shallow and deep copy before and after the weight is materialised), with any initializer helpers it needs in torch_geometric/nn/inits.py; implement to_hetero(model, metadata, aggr='sum') and to_hetero_with_bases(model, metadata, num_bases) in new modules under torch_geometric/nn (dict inputs keyed by node and edge type, per-node-type output dicts, aggregation over edge types sharing a destination type, SparseTensor adjacencies, message-passing submodules keyed by the '__'-joined edge type and other modules by node type; in the basis variant, the converted conv holding a list of basis convolutions each with the original parameters plus an edge_type_weight parameter, and other modules shared as plain submodules), with tests under test/nn. Work under torch_geometric/nn outside torch_geometric/nn/conv and torch_geometric/nn/models; the torch_geometric.nn exports and the type aliases in torch_geometric/typing.py belong to t0, and MessagePassing (with its hook system) and the convolution operators belong to t2.
